description: "Bred in the Bone; Or, Like Father, Like Son: A Novel" by James Payn is a fictional work written during the late 19th century. The story focuses on the eccentric character Carew of Crompton, a fun-loving but reckless squire whose larger-than-life exploits and wild lifestyle have made him infamous in his community.
